attribution.citation: Bennett, J.S., Mutch, E., Tollefson, A. et al. (2025). Cliopatria — A geospatial database of world-wide political entities from 3400BCE to 2024CE. Scientific Data 12, 247. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04516-9
attribution.changes_made: Changes were made. Features filtered to those overlapping this act window; polygons simplified with Douglas-Peucker at 0.25 degrees (topology preserved), invalid geometries repaired, and coordinates snapped to a 0.01 degree grid (2 decimal places); properties reduced to Name (n), FromYear (f), ToYear (t) and Wikidata Q-ID (w).
